title: US female age-specific marriage rates, 2018
author: Valerie Schweizer
underlying_data: NCFMR analyses of the 2018 American Community Survey 1-year estimates
extraction: Manual transcription of the six printed dark-green marriage-rate labels in Figure 3; not digitized from point positions.
source_unit: Women married in last 12 months per 1,000 unmarried women of the same age group
transformation: Divide by 1,000; represent age intervals with exclusive upper bounds and Inf for 65+. No interpolation or hazard conversion.
reuse: Only factual printed numerical values transcribed with attribution. No chart, prose, source code, or claimed open licence copied.
limitations: Pooled first marriages and remarriages; no separate never-married, divorced or widowed schedules.
Current unmarried denominator differs from starting-unmarried denominator in existing 2001 SIPP data; neither measures exact unmarried person-time.
Marriage includes entry after cohabitation; this is not total union formation or a directly estimated search hazard.
Printed source rates rounded to one decimal per 1,000; no precision beyond that is inferred.
No interpolation, simulation changes, or new approval of demographic assumptions.
